WD Blue 1TB 3.5" PC Desktop Internal Hard Drive

Boost your desktop PC storage capacity and daily computing efficiency with the reliable WD Blue 1TB 3.5-inch internal hard drive, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Specifically engineered for use as a primary or secondary drive in desktop PCs, All-in-One workstations, and mainstream computing systems, the WD Blue series delivers solid structural longevity and consistent performance. Operating on the high-bandwidth SATA 6Gb/s interface and equipped with a 64MB high-speed data cache, this 1TB drive provides ample space for your operating system setup, massive office applications, and high-resolution media libraries. Built with Western Digital's strict quality standards and featuring NoTouch Ramp Load technology to safely position the recording head off the disk surface, your essential data remains highly protected against wear and tear. This dependable internal PC upgrade comes backed by a 1-year warranty setup.
